question: For weekly-sales data, I need an analysis of our sales performance around mid-June for the years 2018, 2019, and 2020. Specifically, calculate the percentage change in sales between the four weeks leading up to June 15 and the four weeks following June 15 for each year.
sql:
-- Now calculate the percentage change: (sales_after - sales_before) / sales_before * 100
SELECT 
    calendar_year,
    sales_before,
    sales_after,
    ROUND(1.0 * (sales_after - sales_before) / sales_before * 100, 2) as pct_change
FROM (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        SUM(CASE WHEN (calendar_year = 2018 AND week_number IN (20,21,22,23))
                 OR (calendar_year = 2019 AND week_number IN (20,21,22,23))
                 OR (calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number IN (21,22,23,24))
            THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_before,
        SUM(CASE WHEN (calendar_year = 2018 AND week_number IN (25,26,27,28))
                 OR (calendar_year = 2019 AND week_number IN (25,26,27,28))
                 OR (calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number IN (26,27,28,29))
            THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_after
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
      AND (
        (calendar_year = 2018 AND week_number IN (20,21,22,23,25,26,27,28))
        OR (calendar_year = 2019 AND week_number IN (20,21,22,23,25,26,27,28))
        OR (calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number IN (21,22,23,24,26,27,28,29))
      )
    GROUP BY calendar_year
)
ORDER BY calendar_year

-- 2019: weeks 25,26,27,28 -> should be June 17, June 24, July 1, July 8
-- 2020: weeks 26,27,28,29 -> should be June 22, June 29, July 6, July 13

SELECT DISTINCT calendar_year, week_number, week_date_formatted
FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
WHERE calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)

    (calendar_year = 2018 AND week_number IN (20,21,22,23,25,26,27,28))
